# Contract: vox-explainer

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: video. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Voice-led, word-timed editorial motion graphics: type, quotes, stats, charts, photos and cut-outs, styled by an inspectable preset or a brand kit.

## Use it for
- "make an explainer over this voiceover"
- "animated stats timed to my narration"

## Not for
- a product demo recording (scripted-screencast)

## Accepted inputs
A voiceover (or word timings) and a scene JSON of beats.

## Deliverables
stills, preview and final mp4, motion check.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+
- Node.js 18.19+
- Playwright npm package (npm install)
- Playwright Chromium binary (npx playwright install chromium, ~150-200 MB)
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Optional:
- faster-whisper or mlx-whisper in rough-cut/.venv (weights 0.5-1.5 GB on first use)
- NumPy

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local, except photo beats with a url (captured from that page) and the optional Whisper download.

## Cost-sensitive operations
Rendering time; optional model download.

## Workflow
1. Look first
2. Voice first
3. Beat map
4. Write the scene file
5. Check layouts with stills
6. Preview

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Preset or brand (a taste decision: show one still per preset)
- Beat list before building
- Approve the preview

## Quality checks
- Stills per preset
- motion_check (declared holds allowed, then watched)

## Common failures
- Fonts missing on Windows/Linux (fallback stacks added)
- Beats too long

## Limitations
- Presets other than editorial-collage are provisional

## Reproducible example
The same scene rendered as stills in three presets from a given words file (evidence/vox-explainer).
